text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, oh, thank goodness, it's just you, 
Onii-sama~...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, oh, thank goodness, it's just you, 
Onee-sama~...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I read a scary book before going 
to bed last night...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Worrying about which way the plushies on 
the desk are facing, or hearing the 
ticking of the clock unusually loud...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And then, I started worrying about 
everything... I couldn't sleep at all... 
*yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Rice Shower is sleep-deprived. I 
hope she'll be able to sleep soundly 
soon...
